title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost. We investigate whether general-purpose decision models can guide tuning, using Jev as a deployed representative that returns structured choices and numeric scores across diverse tasks. To assess where it helps, we compare its use as an optimizer, performance predictor, and region guider against conventional methods and a large language model (LLM) on eight AI tuning tasks. Conventional optimizers attain rank 1 in six of eight comparisons. Similarly, established predictors outperform Jev in seven. translated_title: 面向AI配置调优的通用决策模型
translated_abstract: AI配置调优是在有限预算下搜索能够提升AI系统性能的设置。现有调优器使用不同的采样和搜索策略，因此决策策略的选择对调优质量和成本都至关重要。我们研究了通用决策模型能否指导调优，并以Jev作为一个已部署的代表性模型，它可以在多样化任务中返回结构化选择和数值评分。为了评估其在哪些方面有帮助，我们在八个AI调优任务上，将其分别作为优化器、性能预测器和区域引导器，与传统方法及大语言模型（LLM）进行比较。传统优化器在八个比较中的六个中排名第一；同样，成熟的预测器在七个比较中优于Jev。然而，通过区域引导，Jev找到了比原生调优器所选配置困惑度更低的配置，在可以接受额外决策时间和API费用的情况下提供了质量提升。
tldr: 研究发现，通用决策模型Jev在AI配置调优中作为优化器和预测器不及传统方法，但其区域引导功能能找到困惑度更低的配置，在可接受额外决策时间和API费用时带来质量提升。
en_tdlr: General-purpose decision model Jev underperforms conventional methods as an optimizer and predictor in AI configuration tuning, but its region guidance finds configurations with lower perplexity, offering quality gains when extra decision time and API costs are acceptable.
